name: Implicit Surface Voxelization
definition: Voxelization of implicit surfaces by rasterizing rectangles embedded in the Region of Interest (ROI) and evaluating the implicit function in the pixel shader.
summary: Implicit Surface Voxelization converts mathematical implicit surfaces into discrete voxels by rasterizing 2D rectangles and evaluating functions in a pixel shader, distinguishing itself by handling non-polygonal geometry directly.
